problem:
If 
$Q=[\begin{aligned}a & b & a \\ a & -b & a \\ 0 & 0 & a\end{aligned}]$
and
$r=[\begin{aligned}a \\ 0 \\ -a\end{aligned}],$
find $Qr.$

|  |  | {{field-1}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $Qr=\,\,$ |  | {{field-2}} |  |
|  |  | {{field-3}} |  |
worked_solution:
We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product:

$$
\begin{aligned}Qr & =[\begin{aligned}a & b & a \\ a & -b & a \\ 0 & 0 & a\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}a \\ 0 \\ -a\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}a\cdot a & + & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,b\cdot 0 & + & a\cdot (-a) \\ a\cdot a & + & (-b)\cdot 0 & + & a\cdot (-a) \\ 0\cdot a & + & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,0\cdot 0 & + & a\cdot (-a)\end{aligned}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}{a}^{2} & + & 0 & + & (-{a}^{2}) \\ {a}^{2} & + & 0 & + & (-{a}^{2}) \\ 0 & + & 0 & + & (-{a}^{2})\end{aligned}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ -{a}^{2}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
